        )

'

import pytest
from werkzeug import formparser
from werkzeug.datastructures import MultiDict
from werkzeug.exceptions import RequestEntityTooLarge
from werkzeug.formparser import FormDataParser
from werkzeug.test import create_environ
from werkzeug.wrappers import Request


class TestRequestFromValues:
    def test_basic_usage(self):
        data = b'foo=bar&baz=qux'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'bar'
        assert req.form['baz'] == 'qux'

    def test_empty_form(self):
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(),
            content_length=0,
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form == MultiDict()

    def test_multipart_form(self):
        data = (
            b'--foo
'
            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name=", "
'
            b'
'
            b'Hello World
'
            b'--foo--'
        )
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='multipart/form-data; boundary=foo',
            method='POST'
        )
        assert req.form['foo'] == 'Hello World'

    def test_max_form_memory_size_exceeded(self):
        data = b'foo=' + b'a' * 600_000
        with pytest.raises(RequestEntityTooLarge):
            Request.from_values(
                input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
                content_length=len(data),
                content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                method='POST',
                max_form_memory_size=500_000
            )

    def test_max_form_parts_exceeded(self):
        data = b''.join(
            b'--foo
'
            b'Content-Disposition: form-data; name=": "
'
            b'
'
            b'part
'
            for _ in range(1001)
        ) + b'--foo--'
        with pytest.raises(RequestEntityTooLarge):
            Request.from_values(
                input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
                content_length=len(data),
                content_type='multipart/form-data; boundary=foo',
                method='POST',
                max_form_parts=1000
            )

    def test_invalid_content_type(self):
        data = b'foo=bar'
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            Request.from_values(
                input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
                content_length=len(data),
                content_type='invalid/content-type',
                method='POST'
            )

    def test_shallow_flag(self):
        data = b'foo=bar'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST',
            shallow=True
        )
        assert req.shallow is True
        assert 'werkzeug.request' not in req.environ

    def test_populate_request_flag(self):
        data = b'foo=bar'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST',
            populate_request=False
        )
        assert 'werkzeug.request' not in req.environ

    def test_custom_form_data_parser(self):
        class CustomFormDataParser(FormDataParser):
            pass

        data = b'foo=bar'
        req = Request.from_values(
            input_stream=io.BytesIO(data),
            content_length=len(data),
            content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            method='POST',
            form_data_parser_class=CustomFormDataParser
        )
        assert isinstance(req.form_data_parser_class, CustomFormDataParser)
